# Third-party detector

This scaffold intentionally does not copy upstream detector code.

Place the official Deformable DETR repository at
`third_party/Deformable-DETR`, compile its multi-scale deformable-attention
operator, and implement the small adapter described in
`docs/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md`.

Upstream: https://github.com/fundamentalvision/Deformable-DETR
